DWAgent client credential and portal-managed P

Installer: DWAgent-client-auth-x64.exe
Portal update: portal-client-auth-update.zip

Custom names require BOTH the built-in installer credential and a valid portal-managed P.
The built-in credential is sent in an HTTPS Authorization header only for name requests.
The server holds its salted PBKDF2 hash, separately from the portal database's P records.
Missing/wrong installer credential: HTTP 401, no names. Wrong P: HTTP 403, no names.
Changing P in the existing portal does not change the built-in credential. No new TCP port.
Legacy P-only requests keep their old boolean response without names.
Default installation identity remains dwagent.exe, dwagsvc.exe and DWAgent.
Local recovery does not grant server branding. Failed requests clear previously received names.
Known names can be copied manually. A distributed EXE's built-in credential can be extracted and reused.
This is an additional credential check, not proof that the requester is the original EXE.

Validation:
59 installer tests passed; 14 identity/client-credential tests passed; 20 portal tests passed; 17 audit tests passed (110 total).
Native code unchanged from the previous verified build; its two native checks passed.
Final 7-Zip integrity/extraction checks passed. Packaged auth/setup modules match current source and parse as Python 3.8.
Packaged client credential matches the server's salted hash; the server source does not contain its plaintext value.
Default config and profile separation verified; old security-service and example portal names absent from unpacked payload.
The current Windows agent was not installed, stopped, renamed or removed.

Live deployment is pending: SSH requires a private-key file; the existing server has not been changed.
Deploy the updated portal and use this updated EXE together; older EXEs do not contain the new client credential.
After deployment, save your desired names through Installation names in the portal.

Build:
python make/package_windows_installer.py --stub make/tmp/server-identity/installer-stub-x64.exe --runtime-archive installer_payload_20260926221211/stage/runtimepy3.7z --runtime-license installer_payload_20260926221211/stage/LICENSES/runtime --sevenzip C:/Users/HP/scoop/shims/7z.exe --native-dir make/tmp/server-identity/native --install-config os_win_installer/install.json --output dist/DWAgent-client-auth-x64.exe
